bo: nang du khyad par du 'phags pa'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba de nyid tshul khrims kyi rkang pa dang bral ba

target: de'i phyir tshul 'dis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam de dag ma gtogs par so so'i skye bo dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ci rigs par mngon par mtho ba'i 'khor ba'i bde ba dang / nges par legs pa de rtog pa dang dpyod pa dang bral zhing nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas rtog pa med pa dpyod pa med pa ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa bsgrubs te gnas so/ /
src_sentence: sa vitarkavicārāṇāṃ vyupaśamādadhyātmasaṃprasādāccetasa ekotībhāvādavitarkamavicāraṃ samādhijaṃ prītisukhaṃ dvitīyadhyānamupasaṃpadya viharati
